pages.text: Using the powder or the filled syringe adds the bath-salts profile. It changes vision and perception, with view/hand tremor and stronger contextual hallucinations.

pages.title: Recovery
pages.text: High intensity can be lethal, and sleeping while the effect is active can also cause harm. Let it clear before using a bed. Find the recipe chain in $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/obsidian)Obsidian & Bath Salts$(/l).
